scope_change: User requested representative eight-world trial before large-scale labelling.
selection: state-only deterministic greedy stratification over original run-group splits, acts, hp, source-run diversity; no outcomes consulted
sampler: same v4 research stochastic continuation approximation, NOT exact seed posterior
model: same ArmG nonlinear advantage pipeline and source-balanced human preference prior
calibration_gate: same 50 interventions / 15 runs / positive run-cluster bootstrap lower bound, six fixed advantage thresholds; no lowering gates for pilot
large_scale_gate: fresh paired research gate passes AND all replay/input/safety checks pass; no automatic large-scale job if calibration insufficient or evaluation fails
time_limit_behavior: stop new work at stage caps; retain partial states/results; report INCONCLUSIVE rather than treat missing cases as losses or claim verification
